publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for organization location routes and behavior.
Service contract for organization location lifecycle and export projection operations.

dependsOn.description: Locations resolve and authorize their owning organization through the organizationCore public service seam.
Tenant-admin location routes require an active tenant session context.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing many-location, coordinate, or descriptive office flag semantics can break Organization export, search, hours, and admin detail slices.
Changing location route context behavior can break root and tenant scoped child-resource consumers.
